class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackMIDI
class.description: The [AudioStreamPlayback] type instantiated by [AudioStreamMIDI]. Each instance owns its own libADLMIDI player and plays the parent stream's [member AudioStreamMIDI.midi_data] through libADLMIDI's built-in sequencer, so the same [AudioStreamMIDI] resource can be played back concurrently, and independently, by more than one [AudioStreamPlayer]. You don't create this directly; it's returned by [method AudioStreamPlayer.get_stream_playback] after assigning an [AudioStreamMIDI] to the player's stream and starting playback.

method.name: get_song_length
method.description: Returns the total length of the song in seconds, matching [method AudioStream.get_length].

method.name: is_at_end
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if playback has reached the end of the song. Only meaningful once the [code]loop_enabled[/code] parameter is [code]false[/code], or after looping has exhausted the [code]loop_count[/code] parameter.
